name: Lead Search (Event Mode)
description: Time-boxes the capture channel to an event: a stage-driven session template (prep → during → post) whose subject is the event entity. Captures during the event auto-link to it via the session--produced-->entity edge; at the event's endDate the session flips to the `post` stage and the pod-native session-recap reactor posts a recap + a governed follow-ups proposal. NOTE: the `focus_session.stage_changed.post -> session-recap` wiring is realized pod-natively by the session-recap reactor (@synap/events side-effects) — it needs NO per-template automation trigger, so none is declared here.

params.name: eventName
params.label: Event name
params.description: Display name of the event this lead-search session works.

playbooks.name: Lead Search — {{eventName}}
playbooks.goalTemplate: Work {{eventName}} as a lead-search session: prep beforehand, capture every person you meet (as a contact) plus notes during the event, then review the auto-generated recap and follow-ups.
playbooks.description: Event-mode lead capture. Instantiate one session per event, bound to the event entity as its subject; captures made during the window auto-attach to the event.

stages.name: Prep
stages.goal: Research who is attending and set concrete goals for {{eventName}}.
suggestedTasks: List the people or companies you want to meet.
Note your objective for this event (leads, partners, hires).

stages.name: During
stages.goal: Capture every person you meet as a contact, with context notes, as you go.
suggestedTasks: Capture each new contact with name, company, and what they care about.
Jot a one-line note per conversation while it is fresh.

stages.name: Post
stages.description: After the event ends — reached automatically when the event's endDate crosses.
stages.goal: Review the auto-generated recap and act on the proposed follow-ups (intros, messages, deals).
suggestedTasks: Review the recap posted to the channel.
Approve or edit the follow-ups proposal (intros / messages / deals).
